Hi all -

I had a look at the archives and the main web pages for any advice about
running Distance in an emulator, but it doesn't seem like there's a solution
yet. Has anyone had any success with an emulator?

(Note that I mean an *emulator*, not a virtual machine - D6 works fine
virtualised in both VMWare and VirtualBox with WinXP; an emulator

I've installed D6.0 in Wine on the Mac (OSX 10.6) but haven't managed to
succeed yet. I initially got an error relating to VBAJET32.dll, which I
downloaded and put in the WINDOWS directory under Wine - it would start, but
then won't actually work when I try to run analyses.


Regards -
